findings.title: Away mode undoes continuous cleaning
findings.text: When you leave, Away starts both robots without turning continuous cleaning off, so it sends one robot home again. When you come back, Away docks them but leaves continuous cleaning on, so it restarts them about a minute later.

findings.title: Per-robot buttons get undone
findings.text: While continuous cleaning is on, it overrides them within about a minute, and nothing on the dashboard warns you.

findings.title: Switch can show ON while doing nothing
findings.text: Happens when a robot's battery reading is stale. The help text says any battery level works; the real rule is 80% plus a 10-minute returning grace period.

fixes: Away mode turns continuous cleaning ON instead of starting both robots, and OFF on return
One Cleaning card on Home (switch, live status, both batteries, Start both, Dock both); remove the other copies and Quick controls
Correct the relay help text (80% rule + 10-min grace)
Hide or warn on per-robot commands while continuous cleaning is on
Consistent names: Wyze 1, Wyze 2, Continuous cleaning
All Controls view: explicit tap actions, or delete if redundant
Remove duplicate thermostat entities (each floor once)
Show each printer, weather and Codex sensor once; cut ~31 markdown blocks
Remove dead tiles (cool_to_68, Govee power switches, empty lcec refs)
Hand-off trace history 30 → ~200, alert if waiting >30 min
